# Quarterly operations report — May–July 2026

## Summary

The quarter closed with €1,233,225 in revenue against €467,640 in costs,
leaving a net of €765,585 and a 62.1% margin. The trajectory within the
quarter was uneven: revenue rose 4.6% from May to June, then fell 9.6% in
July, ending the quarter below where it started. Customer growth also
cooled — net adds declined each month (69 in May, 52 in June, 32 in July)
as new sign-ups slowed and churn climbed from 17 to 31. Support remained
healthy, closing 95.5% of the 1,001 tickets opened over the quarter.

## Key figures

| Metric | Value |
|---|---|
| Quarterly revenue | €1,233,225 |
| Quarterly costs | €467,640 |
| Net | €765,585 |
| Margin | 62.1% |
| Net customer adds | 153 |
| Ticket close rate | 95.5% |
| June revenue growth | 4.6% |
| July revenue growth | -9.6% |

## Notes

- June's cost lines sum to €158,540, but the June monthly reports a total of
  €158,240 — a €300 discrepancy. Quarterly costs above use the stated totals;
  the June figure should be reconciled.
- Churn rose steadily through the quarter (17 → 22 → 31) while new sign-ups
  fell (86 → 74 → 63). The combination, alongside July's 9.6% revenue drop,
  is the main watch item going into August.
